summary.tldr: Removes plastic manufactured items from the toxic substances list under the Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999.
what_it_does: Repeals item 132 of Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999, which removes plastic manufactured items from the act's list of toxic substances.
summary.background: Item 132 of Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999 lists plastic manufactured items as a toxic substance. The bill would delete that item from the schedule.
